picks.name: Igaxx & Gropina
picks.bio: Tokyo-based Igaxx and Amsterdam-based Gropina on a shared four-track 12" and digital release. "The Perception" (April 9, 2026) pairs Igaxx's original tracks with Gropina's reworks.
picks.why_listen: Near-beatless, spiralling psychedelia on the originals; Gropina's "Version" reworks bring a supernatural, Kraut-inspired lift -- a good pair of headspace tracks for a set's stranger corner.

picks.name: Lena Willikens X Elena Colombi
picks.source_note: Lena Willikens is already seeded (Cómeme roster). Elena Colombi runs Osàre! Editions, which this release is on.
picks.bio: A recorded B2B DJ set from two well-regarded selectors. "Live at Lux Fragil, 2026" (March 31, 2026) is a limited cassette on Elena Colombi's own Osàre! Editions, recorded at the Lisbon club -- Bandcamp exclusive, no repress planned.
picks.why_listen: Not a studio release but a document of an actual set -- useful less as tracks to cue up and more as a reference for how two sharp selectors sequence a night.
